comparator.name: Mathematics (Wiskunde)
comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 OER, current ordinary cohort rules; public year pages indicative 2027–2028, checked 2026-10-08
comparator.sourceNotes: Controlling adopted Dutch OER articles 7.3–7.5: 54 EC first-year required plus 6 EC free; 24 EC later common courses; selected Wiskunde line 36 EC (18 prescribed + 18 restricted, at least 6 from year three); 48 EC later genuinely free; thesis 12 EC. Total 54+6+24+36+48+12=180. First-year Reële Analyse, Statistiek and Wiskunde Practicum follow the formal current table; Introduction to Data Science is not added as another current compulsory unit. RADAr language support is required at 0 EC and not counted as an additional credited component. Writing Skills in Academia is selected from the paired writing alternatives, counted once. The first-listed Wiskunde line is selected neutrally; its restricted choices are the first two eligible year-two rows and first year-three row: Complexe Analyse, Maattheorie, Inleiding PDV, each 6 EC. Later free space remains generic. The ordinary domestic single-degree route retains Bachelor Seminar; conditional waivers for education minor, mobility or double bachelor are not assumed. Article 8.1 permits the old 48-EC line only for entrants in 2024–2025 or earlier, which is not this route. Public year pages all say indicative 2027–2028; their old 48-EC line and 36-EC free-space narrative does not override the current OER. The formal current pathway is reconstructed without asserting guaranteed future timetable availability.

progressionAssessment.rationale: All formal prerequisites and exact Fall 2026-start availability checked against the current workbook. Programming and discrete logic precede algorithmic work; Algorithms and Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms; linear algebra precedes Linear Systems; numerical methods precede Advanced Calculus because of the published timetable. The optimisation course runs alongside introductory mathematical methods after programming and discrete logic; no extra formal mathematics prerequisite is invented.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Two complete programmes pass coherence, availability and distinctness. Probability/statistics and computing interests are already substantive core strands. Medical modelling would require replacing mathematical study with biomedical foundations without a documented mathematical-medicine course sequence; the current workbook lacks the physics/astronomy and mathematics-teaching sequences needed for those two other candidates. These directions cannot independently support another credible 24-course curriculum without weakening the target or adding generic material.

notes.text: Radboud’s selected Wiskunde line includes a deeper sequence in real and complex analysis, abstract algebra, topology, measure theory and partial differential equations. These UCR programmes instead combine mathematical methods with computation, statistics and economic applications; they do not reproduce that pure-mathematics sequence.
